There is no mention of a fixed end date in the agreement or any amendments. The agreement's term is open-ended, subject to termination by either party.

evidence.quote: This Agreement continues until terminated.
Either party may terminate this Agreement on sixty (60) days' written notice.

items.question: Which terms of the storage agreement remain in force after Amendment No. 1?
items.answer:
The storage agreement's terms that remain in force after Amendment No. 1 include all terms except those specifically amended.

The amendment states that "All other terms of the Storage Services Agreement remain in force" [1].

This means that all clauses not modified by Amendment No. 1, such as the services provided, termination procedures, and liability limits, continue to apply. For example, the original clause 3.1, which set the monthly storage fee at EUR 4,000, is no longer in effect, but other clauses like the term and termination provisions in clause 5.1 remain in force [3][3].

Other agreements referenced, such as the Northbridge NDA, Harrowgate MSA, and Unit 7 Lease, are separate documents and not part of the storage agreement.

evidence.quote: All other terms of the Storage Services Agreement remain in force

items.question: How sure is Jonas Ekberg of the time the alarm sounded?
items.answer: The documents indicate that Jonas Ekberg is not certain of the exact time the alarm sounded. He states, "I recall that the temperature alarm sounded at about 02:40 on 18 June 2026. I am not sure of the exact minute" [1].

items.question: What was the Kestrel monthly storage fee before Amendment No. 1?
items.answer: The Kestrel monthly storage fee before Amendment No. 1 was EUR 4,000. This is stated in the Kestrel Storage Services Agreement, which specifies: "Client shall pay a monthly storage fee of EUR 4,000, invoiced on the first business day of each month" [2].
